summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, public data display, alerts, affiliate use, advertising use, or rights-dependent monetization. CONDITIONAL for ordinary reversible fleet growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human counsel review and owner authorization; issue no go-live approval. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not redistribution rights; current Woot terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, and derivative use. Accuracy/freshness, security/release, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown; open findings include banner/consent/GA4 on 18 sites and privacy/terms on 4 sites. Analytics is unavailable for 38 expected sites and must not be treated as zero. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission; no site-level ROI or causal lift is supported. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, processor/vendor obligations, and any affiliate or advertising expansion.

Launch-readiness workstream progress: all four existing SearchWoot legal tasks remain open; none is closed because direct evidence is incomplete. Source rights remain blocked. Alert data flow/retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling remain evidence_needed. Next evidence action: produce one consolidated read-only evidence bundle with repository/configuration references and timestamps for rights, field provenance, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent/unsubscribe, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, log fields, vendor terms/DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Do not enable tracking, expand alerts, deploy, change permissions, add dependencies, or send outreach.

Launch-readiness data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement expressly covering storage, historical derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, field use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and affiliate/advertising use. Smallest next action: attach an authoritative permission record or prepare an owner-approved support request; do not send outreach. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce one read-only data-flow and retention table from repository/configuration evidence. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture current consent behavior and read-only GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, incident process, and data-subject request procedure. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Private or gated-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Evidence: readiness packets are incomplete; complicated.work is unreachable in compliance evidence and has no evidenced banner, consent, GA4, privacy, or terms state; deadlymaracas.com and driveford.net lack completed readiness, security, measurement, and owner decision evidence. Next action: complete one dated readiness packet per site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit launch decision. No publish, DNS change, monetization, telemetry configuration, spending, or queue admission is cleared.
